rows.label: Motor vehicle tax (TVM): annual amounts
rows.value: Private vehicles: up to 7 CV 20,000; 8–10 CV 30,000; 11–15 CV 40,000; above 15 CV 60,000 francs a year. Company passenger cars: 150,000 (up to 7 CV) or 200,000 francs. Three-wheelers 15,000.

rows.label: Accommodation tax (taxe de séjour) per night, by room price
rows.value: 500 francs a night for rooms up to 20,000 francs; 1,500 francs from 20,001 to 100,000; 2,500 francs above 100,000
